summary.text: Jake Blumencranz is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly, representing District 15 since January 2023, and the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jake Blumencranz was born on Long Island and lives in Oyster Bay, New York, and he graduated from Jericho High School.

He earned a B.A. in public policy analysis and religious studies from Rice University in 2018 and a master's degree in development and urban planning from the London School of Economics and Political Science in 2019.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an advisor and coordinator with NFP and as a junior development associate at Time Equities, Inc.
Blumencranz won the November 2024 general election for Assembly District 15 and is not seeking re-election to that seat in 2026.
His committee assignments have included Consumer Affairs and Protection, Science and Technology, and Corporations, Authorities and Commissions.
In the State Senate District 7 general election he faces Democrat Rory Lancman.
